column1: Knowledge
The demo as-of date is 2026-09-25. Any question about today or now refers to that date. The latest complete ISO week runs 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-20 and the latest inventory snapshot is 2026-09-21.
Bayview Regional Health (CUST-0001) is the largest customer at $48.2M annual contract value and renews on 2026-12-15. It is served by DC-ATL and managed by Dana Whitfield.

Vanterra (NDC 61234-0101-04) is a GLP-1 pen from Veltrix Biopharma on manufacturer allocation. Veltrix held Halcyon's allocation flat through June and July 2026 while demand grew, then cut it in August and again in September 2026. Halcyon splits allocation by historical share, so fast-growing customers see the largest shortfall while a handful of slow customers use less than 60 percent of what they are allocated.

Order value on allocated products is not a demand signal because customers over-request when they expect to be shorted. Judge whether a customer is shifting business away using non-allocated (discretionary) order value, which V_CUSTOMER_HEALTH exposes as DISCRETIONARY_VALUE_CHANGE_PCT.
HALCYON_TOTAL_ALLOCATION_UNITS repeats on every customer row for the same NDC and month. Use MAX at NDC and month grain. Summing it multiplies the allocation by the number of customers.

COLD_CHAIN_EVENTS rows are logger readings, not problems. Excursion questions must filter IS_EXCURSION = TRUE. Excursion rate is SUM(excursions) divided by SUM(readings), compared within the same storage class and stage.

DC-MEM began using GEL_PACK_STD packaging for a share of refrigerated packouts in June 2026. PHASE_CHANGE_48H is the higher-cost alternative. Packaging type is the first thing to compare when a DC's packout excursion rate rises.

Oncaryl (NDC 58771-0410-01) is an oncology infusion vial from Amberline Oncology with a WAC of $2,850. Demand from Dallas-served sites fell sharply from May 2026 while three Houston oncology practices (Gulfstream Cancer Care, Bayou City Oncology Group, Lone Star Hematology Oncology Associates) kept ordering it from DC-DAL.

Short-dated specialty product inside 90 days of expiry usually cannot be returned to the manufacturer for full credit. Options are transfer to a DC with demand, a short-dated sale to a nearby customer, or write-off.

Keldon Pharma (MFR-002) loaded a new contract price file, version 2026-04A, effective 2026-04-15. Chargeback dispute rates on Keldon claims rose sharply after that date with PRICE_MISMATCH and INELIGIBLE_CUSTOMER as the main reasons.
A chargeback dispute rate of 3 to 5 percent is normal. A single manufacturer above 15 percent points to a price file or eligibility mismatch rather than a customer issue.
Backorders open more than 14 days are the escalation threshold. Most HIGH and CRITICAL PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY service cases are linked to backorders older than 14 days through RELATED_BACKORDER_ID.
Line fill rate of 97 to 98 percent is normal for Halcyon. A customer sustained below 90 percent is a service problem, and on a Strategic account inside 120 days of renewal it is a retention problem.

Sites on the AUTO_REPLENISH channel have the highest line fill rate and place no STAT orders because Halcyon manages their par levels. Auto-replenishment is the preferred channel and an expansion lever.

ORDER_LINES.QTY_SHIPPED is the first release only. Backorders that later ship appear in BACKORDERS with STATUS RELEASED; the order line is not updated. Line fill rate therefore measures first-pass service.
INVENTORY_SNAPSHOTS is weekly. Current inventory means the 2026-09-21 snapshot or V_INVENTORY_RISK. Summing across snapshot dates double counts.
Chargebacks exist only for contract-priced shipped lines. Customers without a GPO and products not on the customer's GPO contract generate no chargeback.

The operational risk score in V_CUSTOMER_HEALTH is a triage aid built from fill rate deterioration (35), backorder aging (25), service cases and escalations (25) and discretionary volume decline (15). Describe it as an operational risk indicator, never as a churn prediction.
Holiday weeks in CALENDAR (IS_US_HOLIDAY) have no orders. Do not read a holiday week dip as a demand change. The week starting 2026-09-21 is partial and should be excluded from weekly trends.

Halcyon ships same business day for next-day delivery. PROMISED_SHIP_DATE equals the order date; PROMISED_DELIVERY_DATE is the next business day for STANDARD and URGENT orders and the same day for STAT courier orders.
